brutal-io.title: Brutal.io: Free Online Multiplayer Game
brutal-io.description: Brutal.io is an addictive multiplayer online game where players control a small vehicle with a flail attached to it. The objective is to swing your flail and hit other players' vehicles to destroy them and collect their energy. Experience intense battles, strategic gameplay, and endless fun in Brutal.io. Join now and dominate the arena!
